title: rorippa curvipes var. alpina
intro: Rorippa curvipes var. alpina, commonly known as Alpine Yellow Cress, is a type of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. Alpine Yellow Cress has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Yellow Cress include glucosinolates, which have been shown to exhibit anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory activities.
